title: Second Shot
tagline: Click twice, exactly the target time apart. Furthest off is out each round.

title: Gallery Guess
tagline: Everyone picks photos from their camera roll. Guess whose photo it is, fast.

title: Odd Word Out
tagline: Everyone gets the secret word, except the impostor. One clue each, then vote out the bluffer.

title: Guess the Word
tagline: Phone on your forehead, the others describe. Tilt down if you got it, tilt up to pass.

title: Most Likely Boom
tagline: “Who is most likely to …?” Hand the phone to that person. A hidden bomb is ticking: hold it when it blows and you lose.
